ProjectFocus.target.cfg.ref: Target focus at 3 projects and Home, 3 requests, 1 library change, budget 2, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry; every safety property holds. The plan's 4 requests run in wide.

ProjectFocus.target-one-project.cfg.ref: Budget 1 at the target bounds with 1 failed session start: the registry closes the session being left through its close flush, a failed start gives held, focus never closes, and every safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.target-idle-expiry.cfg.ref: Idle expiry at any step over 3 projects and Home, 3 requests, no library change, budget 2, 1 failed leave flush and 1 retry; every safety property holds. The pr form of target-idle-expiry-wide, narrowed to no library change to fit the per-target budget.

ProjectFocus.target-idle-expiry-wide.cfg.ref: Idle expiry at any step at the target bounds (3 projects and Home, 1 library change); every safety property holds. Nightly: about 42 s on the CI runner, which put the family target over the per-target budget; target-idle-expiry is its narrowed pr form.

ProjectFocus.target-person-commands.cfg.ref: Two person opens and two closes interleaved with 3 requests over 3 projects, no Home, no library change; OpenCarriesRequest and every other safety property hold.

ProjectFocus.target-person-epoch.cfg.ref: Budget 1 over 2 projects, 3 requests, 1 library change, 2 person opens and 1 person close, no Home or failed flush or close: a library change drops every kept request, so focus withdraws a person's waiting open whose kept request was dropped; every target safety property holds. Keeps this interaction at pr since target-retained-session's pr form has no library change.

ProjectFocus.target-same-project.cfg.ref: 2 projects, 2 chats, 4 requests, 1 library change, budget 2; a same-project commit keeps the editor with at most one ChatForwarded, and every safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.target-open-facts.cfg.ref: Facts in any order over 2 projects, 3 requests, 1 library change, 1 person open and close; EditorOnlyWhenReady, FirstCheckBeforeEditor and every other safety property hold.

ProjectFocus.target-retained-session.cfg.ref: Budget 1 over 2 projects, 3 requests, no library change, 2 person opens, 1 person close, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry, 1 failed close (back to live or to failed), 1 discard, no Home: a session whose close fails is retained with its unsaved work, and DirtyNeverDiscarded and every target safety property hold. The pr form of target-retained-session-wide, narrowed to no library change to fit the per-target budget.

ProjectFocus.target-retained-session-wid.ref: target-retained-session with 1 library change: budget 1 over 2 projects, 3 requests, 2 person opens, 1 person close, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry, 1 failed close, 1 discard, no Home; DirtyNeverDiscarded and every target safety property hold. Nightly: about 104 s on the CI runner, which put the family target over the per-target budget.

ProjectFocus.target-retained-session-rea.ref: At the target-retained-session bounds the ruled case is reached: flushFailed, a person's open waiting, and the dirty session being left retained after its close failed.

ProjectFocus.target-failed-close-withdra.ref: Budget 1 over 2 projects, 4 requests, no library change, 2 person closes, 1 failed close, no person open, Home, failed leave flush or retry: on a close that fails to failed, focus withdraws its waiting open, so no later close of that session respawns it from focus's request, and OpenOnlyOnCurrentAccess and every target safety property hold.

ProjectFocus.target-resume-window.cfg.ref: At the target bounds the registry may resume focus's pending open after a library change focus has not yet noticed; focus then re-asks before any join. A witness of the window the registry, as environment, leaves.

ProjectFocus.target-registry-epoch.cfg.ref: At the target bounds with RegistryChecksEpoch (A5c): the registry never resumes focus's open on a stale epoch and replies when it drops one, so focus never settles on closed for a project nobody closed (NoSpuriousClosed); every target safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.liveness.cfg.ref: LiveSpec over 2 projects and Home, 3 requests, 1 library change, budget 1; RequestEventuallySettles and FailedFlushSendsNoOpen hold.

ProjectFocus.liveness-person-commands.cf.ref: LiveSpec over 2 projects, 3 requests, no library change, budget 1, 1 person open and 1 person close, no Home or flush failure; RequestEventuallySettles and FailedFlushSendsNoOpen hold. The pr form of liveness-person-commands-wide, narrowed to no library change to fit the per-target budget.

ProjectFocus.liveness-person-commands-wi.ref: LiveSpec over 2 projects, 3 requests, 1 library change, budget 1, 1 person open and 1 person close, no Home or flush failure; RequestEventuallySettles and FailedFlushSendsNoOpen hold. Nightly: about 49 s on the CI runner, which put the family target over the per-target budget; liveness-person-commands is its narrowed pr form.

ProjectFocus.liveness-person-budget.cfg.ref: LiveSpec over 2 projects, 3 requests, no library change, budget 2, 2 person opens and 2 person closes, 1 failed session start, no Home or flush failure; RequestEventuallySettles, FailedFlushSendsNoOpen and OpeningWaitsOrWentLive hold.

ProjectFocus.liveness-retained-reopen.cf.ref: LiveSpec over 2 projects, 3 requests, no library change, budget 1, 1 person close, 1 failed close (back to live or to failed), no person open, Home or leave-flush failure; focus's open for a retained session goes live through the reopen or is withdrawn and re-sent on budgetRefused and settles on the failed session as closed, and RequestEventuallySettles, FailedFlushSendsNoOpen and OpeningWaitsOrWentLive hold.

ProjectFocus.liveness-registry-epoch.cfg.ref: LiveSpec over 2 projects and Home, 3 requests, 1 library change, budget 1, with RegistryChecksEpoch; RequestEventuallySettles and FailedFlushSendsNoOpen hold.

ProjectFocus.today-late-effect.cfg.ref: Today with the late registration at 3 projects and Home, 3 requests, no library change, budget 2, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry: an edit before the registration lands is still flushed on the next navigation, and every today safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.today-late-effect-reachable.ref: Today with the late registration at 3 projects and Home, 3 requests, 1 library change, budget 2, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry: an edit before ProjectPersistenceGuard registers the flush is reachable, so today-late-effect is not vacuous.

ProjectFocus.today-held-skips-flush.cfg.ref: I3 at the target bounds: today, a held answer drops the flush registration, so leaving the held project for another skips the leave flush of its unsaved work. The target holds FlushBeforeLeave; A5b moves the leave flush to focus.

ProjectFocus.today-superseded-open.cfg.ref: Today at 3 projects and Home, 3 requests, no library change; a request superseded during the leave flush is fenced and the today safety properties hold.

ProjectFocus.today-superseded-open-reach.ref: Today at 3 projects and Home, 3 requests, no library change, budget 2, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry: the superseded-during-flush interleaving is reachable, so today-superseded-open is not vacuous.

ProjectFocus.today-stale-return.cfg.ref: I4 at the target bounds: today, returning to the resolved project after a library change opens it on the old epoch's answer. The target holds it; A5b moves the open path to focus.

ProjectFocus.today-library-retry.cfg.ref: I3 at the target bounds: today, a library change re-runs the access effect after a failed leave flush and leaves flushFailed without Retry. Programme control ruled a library change does not retry the flush; A5a implements that on purpose.

ProjectFocus.today-module-race.cfg.ref: U1 at the target bounds: today derives editor while the project runtime import is still loading.

ProjectFocus.today-first-check.cfg.ref: U13 and U20 at the target bounds: today derives editor before the first file check settles and before the open bound.

ProjectFocus.no-request-id.cfg.ref: At the target bounds without the id fence, the answer for an older request focuses its project under a newer request: the id is necessary.

ProjectFocus.no-route-in-selector.cfg.ref: At the target bounds a selector without the committed route shows the previous request's state for a route focus has not taken: the selector needs the route.

ProjectFocus.match-by-request-id.cfg.ref: At the target bounds with two chats, matching by request id tears the editor down on a chat switch: the comparison must be by project.

ProjectFocus.export.cfg.ref: The labelled export at 2 projects and Home, 3 requests, no library change or failure; every safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.wide.cfg.ref: Nightly: 4 projects and Home, 4 requests, 1 library change, budget 2, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry; every safety property holds. The plan named 6 requests and 2 library changes; 4 requests with 2 library changes already take about 15 minutes (10.9M distinct states), the nightly watchdog, so wide keeps 1 library change.
